visual_identity.core_identity: A humanoid upper body fused directly to the body of a giant spider, combining deliberate weapon use with eight-legged arachnid movement.
visual_identity.silhouette: Humanoid torso rising from the front of a broad spider abdomen, eight long spider legs radiating below and around, bow held above.
visual_identity.head_features: Elven or severe humanoid face with pointed ears, long hair or simple head covering, no insect head.
visual_identity.body_shape: Humanlike chest and arms merge at the waist into a giant spider cephalothorax and abdomen with eight legs.
visual_identity.surface: Humanoid skin and cloth kept simple; spider lower body uses sparse hair and broad plates.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Exactly two humanoid arms emerge from the upper torso. The humanoid waist fuses directly into one spider cephalothorax/abdomen assembly with exactly eight spider legs; no human legs, horse body, or extra limb pair.
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw one fused creature: a humanoid upper torso with exactly two arms rising directly from a giant spider lower body with exactly eight jointed legs. The waist-to-spider fusion must be continuous and obvious; add no human legs, centaur body, or separate spider companion.

accuracy_checks: fusion between torso and spider body is clear
secondary material does not overwhelm anatomy

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.

description: A humanoid upper body fused directly to the body of a giant spider, combining deliberate weapon use with eight-legged arachnid movement. Humanlike chest and arms merge at the waist into a giant spider cephalothorax and abdomen with eight legs. Humanoid skin and cloth kept simple; spider lower body uses sparse hair and broad plates.

scene_identity.size_impression: Large fused humanoid-spider creature whose broad eight-legged lower body visibly supports a normal-sized humanoid upper torso.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Spider lower body carries the weight on eight legs while the humanoid torso remains upright enough for deliberate hand/weapon use.

known_failure_modes.symptom: lower body becomes horse-like or gains human legs
known_failure_modes.correction: restore continuous waist fusion into spider cephalothorax/abdomen with exactly eight spider legs

known_failure_modes.symptom: spider lower body has fewer or more than eight legs
known_failure_modes.correction: restore exactly eight jointed spider legs and no human legs
